sentences.text: Shri Mahendra Choubey - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Veer Vikrant Singh - Dy. Advocate General for the State of M.P.

Heard on I.A. No.29100/2025,
which is first application under Section 430(1) of BNSS/389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
This appeal is filed being aggrieved of the judgment dated 15/10/2025 passed by the learned Special Judge, Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act 2012, Mandla, district Mandla, (MP) in S.C.
No.26/2023 whereby appellant stand convicted and sentenced as under:-
 Conviction S e n t e n ce  Section Act Imprisonment Fine i  fine deposi  detail  376 (2) N IPC Nil Nil   366 IPC R.I. for 5 years Rs.100  
 5L r/w Protection of R.I. for 20 Rs.200 Section 6 Children years   from Sexual  Offences Act  363 IPC Nil Nil  It is submitted that D.N.A. report (Ex.P-36) is negative.
Apparently the victim was in relationship with someone else and she has falsely implicated the 2 CRA-11917-2025 present appellant.
It is also submitted that victim actually wanted to marry with the appellant but when he denied then he has been falsely implicated.
There are good chances of success.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.

sentences.text: Shri Veer Vikrant Singh, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State supports the impugned judgment and opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence.

Taking these facts into consideration and also considering the fact that there appears to be good chances of success in appeal, without commenting on merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of jail sentence of appellant and release him on bail.
Accordingly, I.A. No.29100/2025 is allowed and disposed of.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount each to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court 1st of July 2026 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of appellant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
C c as per rules.
 (VIVEK AGARWAL) (AVANIND  JUDGE   bks Krishna @ Krishan Kumar Markam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 25 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99736947/
